item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Geo-redundancy on Azure App Service
item.description:
Azure App Service geo-redundancy is now in public preview. It lets customers build more resilient web apps across Azure regions without having to separately create and manage an App Service deployment in each region.

  • Source: Azure Updates
